source_snapshot.items: NVQual - PCIE Link Disable and Enable Test
source_snapshot.procedure: 10,000 disable/enable loops on all bridges with endpoints.

old_problem: No safe link allowlist, cycle timing, disappearance/re-enumeration/speed/width/error/data-integrity oracle or recovery.
disposition_reason: Disable/enable purpose and count are explicit; platform targets and per-cycle recovery evidence can be strict runtime gates.
decision_basis: Preserved 10,000 cycles and all approved endpoint paths.

test_case.purpose: Disable and re-enable every approved PCIe link 10,000 times and prove disappearance, re-enumeration, link state and data integrity each cycle.
test_case.test_command: Drain workloads; capture baseline; cycle only allowlisted links one at a time; for each cycle prove expected loss and recovery, negotiated state, error and integrity; stop on first failure; restore baseline.
test_case.expected_result: All cycles complete on every target with exact re-enumeration/state/integrity and no new error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Readable output/FW or final-only inventory cannot PASS 10,000 cycles.
test_case.recovery: Stop, re-enable link through approved method, recover device/driver via OOB if needed and preserve failed cycle.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind module, targets, timing, oracle and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; RUNTIME AUTHORIZATION REQUIRED; NOT EXECUTED

project_authority: Safe links and recovery are topology-specific.
